cyclic4.note: W>X>Y>W cycle; Z loses to everyone. Knockout winner depends on who meets whom.

transitive4.note: W beats everyone; X beats Y and Z; Y beats Z. Condorcet winner W is also the knockout winner under every seeding.

tied_wx.note: W vs X is a declared pairwise tie. Match resolution must use the declared seeding-independent tie-break, not the left bracket slot.
